summary: Iter 11 testing covered: (1) Forgot/reset password endpoints (generic responses, token validation), (2) Login announcement banner (public endpoint, super_admin create visible on /login, guru coerced to show_on_login=false), (3) Org structure editor unlimited depth, add child via 'Bawahan' button, cycle guard, cascade delete, Lapis labels, public GET endpoint non-demo filter. Backend pytest 11/11 PASSED. Frontend Playwright: login banner renders with 'Libur Semester' announcement; forgot-password-link visible on /login; forgot-password page accessible; org editor renders OrgTree with connectors; added UITEST_A at Lapis 3 then UITEST_B at Lapis 4 (unlimited depth confirmed) and cascade-deleted both; parent-select pre-selected to clicked card's id. 'Lapis N' labels found 7 times matching 7 cards after cleanup. GET /api/org/public works (non-auth, no is_demo items).

minor.issue: Resend/Emergent email returns 422 when 'to' is @sekolahku.id (unverified domain) e.g. guru.demo@sekolahku.id. Emails to real addresses (boassibarani123@gmail.com) succeed and 'Reset email sent to ...' is logged. Not a code bug but worth noting: backend logs 'Reset email failed: Client error 422 unknown' for demo accounts. User still gets generic 200 message (no info leak).

integration_issues.issue: Component /app/frontend/src/pages/PublicOrg.jsx exists and renders OrgTree with testid=public-org-tree, but it is NOT imported/routed anywhere in App.js/index.js. Visiting /org/public returns an empty page (no element with data-testid=public-org-tree). Backend endpoint GET /api/org/public works; just the FE route is missing.

action_items: (Optional) Register PublicOrg route (e.g. <Route path='/org/public' element={<PublicOrg/>} />) in App.js if public access to the org chart is intended by the UX. Backend API already supports it.
(Optional) In send_reset_email, swallow 422 silently for unverified recipient domains or log at debug (currently logs ERROR which may be noisy for demo accounts). Not critical.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot-password rate-limit (5/15min) inserts a row BEFORE checking the count, so the 5th request is still processed (recent<5 at insertion time but the 6th is throttled). Reasonable design; just FYI.
OrgTree.jsx line 77 uses React.createElement for recursion (same pattern retained from iter10) — functional and justified as a workaround for babel plugin.
No defensive upper-bound on org depth; relies on client stack. For enormously deep inputs recursion in delete_org/_delete_subtree could blow stack (practical risk is negligible).
PublicOrg.jsx is dead code if not routed — either wire the route or remove the file to avoid confusion.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows verified except PublicOrg which has unrouted component — minor)
